objective: Fix 9 build errors in KampBypass.lean to achieve green build

verification.notes: All 9 errors fixed. Build passes with 993 jobs. 4 pre-existing sorries remain (all out of scope for this dispatch).

memory_candidates: In KampBypass.lean, when proving Bool.eq_false goals for ssn order atoms, use ssn_order_consistent_of_eval to get order consistency, then revert + cases on the two relevant order booleans + simp_all. This extracts antisymmetry (if ssn(.order 0 1)=true then ssn(.order 1 0)=false) without needing to destructure the 13-conjunct ssn_order_consistent proposition manually.

For temporal_truth goals involving Formula.neg, use rw [temporal_truth_neg] (from StaviConnectives.lean) instead of simp only [temporal_truth]. The simp only [temporal_truth] cannot unfold through .neg because it wraps the formula in .impl and .bot.

When cases on Bool values produces goals with mismatched Fin proof terms (ssn_xt_compatible._proof_3 vs by omega), use first | rfl | exact hsub.symm | (exfalso; simp_all) instead of plain simp_all. The exact hsub.symm leverages the kernel's definitional equality to close matching cases where rfl and simp fail due to lambda body proof term differences.
